xmldoc.short_description: Apply morphological operations to binary images.

param_input_item.param_description: 2-D numeric or logical binary image. Nonzero values are treated as true.
Number of iterations. It must be a nonnegative integer scalar or Inf. The default value is 1.

param_output_item.param_description: Logical image after applying the requested operation.

description.p: Apply binary morphological operations to a 2-D image.
Dilate, erode, open, close, tophat, and bothat use a 3-by-3 square neighborhood.
The iteration count n can be a nonnegative integer or Inf.

example_item.example_item_description: Remove endpoints from a binary line
